officialCodeSystem: ISTAT Limiti delle unità amministrative 2026 (1 January 2026): COD_REG 1-20 regions, COD_UTS/COD_PROV/COD_CM 110 province-tier units (provinces, metropolitan cities 201-210/312/318, autonomous provinces, Friuli non-administrative units, Sardinia 2025 reform codes 112-119), PRO_COM_T 6-digit comune codes
excludedKinds: ripartizione geografica (RipGeo layer — statistical grouping, not administration)

superseded legacy provinces whose identity cannot be established from this release: the 2025 Sardinian reform re-created the provincial layer with new ISTAT codes 112-119 and reused siglas (OT now = Gallura Nord-Est Sardegna, CI = Sulcis Iglesiente, VS = Medio Campidano, OG = Ogliastra; SS/CA became metropolitan cities), so legacy iso3166-2:IT-CA/SS/NU/OR/SU are removed with explicit superseded records — sigla equality alone is not identity
sourceBaseline: istat-limits-2026-generalized (Reg 20 + ProvCM 110 + Com 7,896 attribute rows; geometry generalization does not affect codes or names)
parentRule: comune→province-tier unit by COD_PROV (the ProvCM COD_PROV set covers every comune row); province→region by COD_REG; regions→country
idRule: the 20 region ids stay legacy iso3166-2:IT-21..88 (fixed official ISO↔ISTAT region table); province ids stay legacy iso3166-2:IT-{SIGLA} where the sigla maps precisely OUTSIDE the Sardinia reform (101 units, metro-city conversions like IT-TO→201 Torino are entity continuations recorded by TIPO_UTS); province-tier units without a legacy match (Valle d'Aosta province, 8 Sardinia reform entities) use it-prov:{COD_UTS}; comunes use it-comune:{PRO_COM_T 6 digits}
nameRule: official Italian names from DEN_UTS/COMUNE verbatim (nameLocale=it, nameQuality=source-native) on new nodes; preserved legacy region/province ids keep their inherited names per the design §7 rule (identity unchanged); the source-provided COMUNE_A bilingual alternative name is written as the node alias when non-empty (124 comuni, never generated by name similarity)
abolishedRule: the boundaries release is a Gebietsstand snapshot and carries no abolished rows; the adapter still routes abolished comune rows to migration records (fixture-proven). Real abolishments/merges live in ISTAT's separate administrative-variation dataset, which is not part of this release
